visual_action: The video shows the process of making honey at the White House. It begins with shots of a miniature White House model with bees flying around it and a bee smoker being used. It then cuts to close-ups of bees on a honeycomb, a beekeeper handling the frames, and bees on flowers. A person, partially seen, carries a basket of honeycomb frames. A person wearing a chef's hat is briefly shown. The video then shows honey being scraped from the comb and dispensed from a spigot into small glass jars. Finally, a person applies a white label with the presidential seal and the text 'White House Honey' to a jar. The video ends with a shot of several finished jars of honey.

cast.name: The White House
cast.evidence: The video is from the official @whitehouse account, features a model of the building, and showcases the production of 'White House Honey' with the presidential seal on the label.
